note: Measured from two screen recordings of the same rocket: the fins' up/down extent ratio sweeps 0.50-2.01 in this app and 0.51-2.00 in desktop OpenRocket, against 0.50-2.00 predicted for a three-fin set - the two draw the same projection, and a three-fin rocket's side view genuinely does rock as it rolls. What differs is that the desktop figure is a wireframe with no occlusion, so every fin outline is on screen at all times. The covered part of a fin here was a 70%-opacity hairline that read as a smudge; it is now a full-strength dashed outline, so a fin passing behind the airframe stays followable. No numbers change.
